subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should the shared ClickClack REST client enforce an unconditional 30-second completion deadline for startup, fetch, delivery, and activity operations?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and well proven, but choosing the maximum legitimate ClickClack REST duration is an owner-level compatibility decision not defined by current repository contracts.

options.title: Adopt 30 seconds internally
options.body: Keep the private constant and accept timeout failures for ClickClack REST responses that do not fully complete within 30 seconds.

options.title: Retune the private deadline
options.body: Select a different owner-informed duration while preserving the same private implementation and regression-proof shape.

recommendation.title: Adopt 30 seconds internally
recommendation.body: Keep the private constant and accept timeout failures for ClickClack REST responses that do not fully complete within 30 seconds.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest prior REST response-completion hardening in the same implementation and test files.
